resources.string: The village originated from the merging of two settlements: Castellar, to the north of the Carretera del Pi, and l\'Oliveral, to the south.
Iglesia de Nuestra Señora de Lepanto
The parish of Castellar, one of the stops on the City Council’s ‘Pobles del Sud’ (Southern Villages) route.
Protected 18th-century farmhouse with a colonnaded courtyard, surrounded by orange trees.
A rural path between L\'Oliveral and Pinedo, featuring *barracas* (traditional thatched cottages) and traditional houses alongside the Albufera.
A small jetty set among canals and rice paddies. In the past, boats laden with rice would arrive here for threshing.
The lake at El Saler, in the heart of La Devesa. One of the best spots to watch the sunset.
